statement_record.book: A group structure on a set G is the bare data of a unit u : 1 -> G, an inverse i : G -> G and a multiplication m : G x G -> G with NO equations; packing them as one arrow gamma = [u,i,m] : 1 + G + G x G -> G exhibits it as an algebra for the Sets-endofunctor F(X) = 1 + X + X x X, and a map h : G -> H preserving unit, inverse and multiplication pointwise is exactly one satisfying h o gamma = theta o F(h). These form the category GrpStr.
